Tabular lining figures for times and counts in a running story; optical sizing on for Literata.
Signature
Density as the voice: capitals in a condensed face at line height 0.9, stacked over a hard rule, with three columns of briefs right under it. No hero image needed; the page is the story list.
Use when
Local news, live updates, election and event coverage, internal status pages written for a wide audience.
Turns into slop when
When the condensed capitals are used for a calm product (it shouts for nothing), when tracking is added to the condensed capitals, or when the columns hold filler instead of real items.
